learned counsel for the applicant in BA 1st No.1561 of

the applicant in BA 1st No.1578 of 2025.
4. Mr. Arvind Vashistha, learned senior counsel for 
the applicant in BCA No.28 of 2025 and in C528 
No.2012 of 2025.
5. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned AGA for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
6. It is argued by the learned counsel for the 
applicants as well as the learned counsel for the 
complainant that the entire investigation is faulty. The 
record of BA1st No.240 of 2025, “Anant Jain Vs. State of 
Uttarakhand” is also attached, in which the applicant 
was already enlarged on bail by this Court on 
24.07.2025, and these matters was heard on several 
dates and in that matter also, the learned counsel for 
the applicant seriously attack on the faulty 
investigation, which itself is reflected from the 
complete order-sheet.
7. As per the prosecution, there is only one 
clinching evidences, which is the recovery of the blood 
stained Jacket and the knife recovered on the pointing 
out of the accused Naveen Kumar.
8. The petition has been filed by the complainant 
under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023, wherein, he is praying 
for further investigation.
9. Let the State may file their objections.
10. List these matters on 20.08.2026. 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
